source: Ville de Geneve / Canton de Geneve, SITG (Systeme d'Information du Territoire a Geneve), Inventaire cantonal des arbres isoles (SIPV_ICA_ARBRE_ISOLE), filtered to REMARQUABLE IS NOT NULL
endpoint: https://vector.sitg.ge.ch/arcgis/rest/services/SIPV_ICA_ARBRE_ISOLE/FeatureServer/0 (outSR=4326 served correctly reprojected from native EPSG:2056/LV95)
licence: SITG 'Conditions generales d'utilisation des donnees et produits du SITG en libre acces', access level A (Acces libre / Open Data)
licence_proof: Fetched live from sitg.ge.ch/ressources/conditions-utilisation-donnees (2026-08-15): the page states an attribution requirement ('Vous devez obligatoirement indiquer la source (ex : "Donnees SITG", date/frequence d'extraction)') and explicitly permits, for level-A/Acces-libre data, to 'reproduire, copier, transmettre, diffuser, publier, adapter, modifier, transformer, combiner le jeu de donnees notamment pour la creation d'informations derivees... y compris pour une utilisation commerciale' (including for commercial use). GAP TO FLAG: this pass read the general SITG CGU page (which governs the whole Level A/A* tiering) but could NOT directly confirm, from a per-dataset access-level tag, that SIPV_ICA_ARBRE_ISOLE itself is tagged Level A rather than the more restricted A* (the layer's own metadata PDF, bundled in the download zip, uses a font/text encoding this pass's tooling could not extract cleanly). Circumstantial evidence for Level A: the dataset is listed on opendata.swiss (Switzerland's national open-data catalogue, which by policy indexes open datasets) and every download route tested (WFS, WMS, REST FeatureServer, CSV/SHP/GDB zip) served without any authentication or paywall gate. A future pass should read the layer's own catalogue fiche on sitg.ge.ch (JS-rendered, needs a browser session) to close this gap with a direct per-dataset quote.
designation: REMARQUABLE field on the canton's own bulk isolated-tree inventory: not a separate legal protection register like Portugal/Czech/Poland, but a per-tree flag the canton itself applies within its full survey to mark a tree as noteworthy ('Autre' = other reason, 'Dimension' = size). Same pattern as Bordeaux and Toulouse's French municipal inventories: a bulk dataset (239,124 rows total for this layer) that our semantic filter would otherwise forbid, made usable by pulling only the subset the source itself designates.
scope: 205 of the canton's 239,124 surveyed isolated trees carry a non-null REMARQUABLE value (204 'Autre', 1 'Dimension'). All 205 imported; none excluded at import time beyond the semantic filter itself.
caveat: Three things a run must know before using this. (1) Circumference (CIRCONFERENCE_1M) reads correctly in centimetres, sanity-checked: range 132cm-951cm, mean ~495cm, no metres-mislabelled trap. Height in metres (6-40m) also checked plausible. (2) DATE_PLANTATION carries a recurring exact sentinel value, -4986057600000ms = 1812-01-01, on 13 of the 84 dated entries: this is almost certainly a database placeholder for 'planting date unknown' rather than 13 trees genuinely planted on the same New Year's Day, so those 13 are stored here with planted: null and planted_is_placeholder_date: true rather than a fabricated date; the same caution should be applied to any OTHER Geneva tree pulled from this source later, since the sentinel will recur across the full 239k-row inventory. Where DATE_PLANTATION is a real date, DATE_PLANTATION_ESTIMEE flags whether it is itself an estimate (stored as planted_is_estimate). (3) A genuine vitality field exists (VITALITE: Bon/Excellent/Mediocre/Mauvais) and a stump flag (SOUCHE), which caught a real contradiction: one entry (ID_ARBRE 14346, a Cedrus deodara) carries SOUCHE='Oui' (stump) while VITALITE still reads 'Bon' (good), source data disagreeing with itself. That entry is marked publishable: false with the contradiction recorded in death_signal rather than trusted either way. ESPERANCE_VIE ('life expectancy') looks like a target YEAR (values cluster around 2050-2100) rather than a duration in years; treated as informational only, not used for any age claim.

entries.death_signal: SOUCHE (stump) field = 'Oui' despite VITALITE recorded as 'Bon'; contradictory source data, needs verification before shipping
